artist_notes.name: Bag Raiders
artist_notes.note: Australian duo behind 'Shooting Stars' (the meme); Modular-era electro-house.

artist_notes.name: Uffie
artist_notes.note: Ed Banger-era electroclash voice ('Pop the Glock'), tied to Justice and Feadz.

artist_notes.name: CSS
artist_notes.note: Brazilian indie-dance band, Sub Pop-era blog-house staple.

curator_note: Blog-era nostalgia done with the actual artists, not a tribute act. Not groove-night material, but a ten-year-anniversary bill this stacked is a fun Friday if you were there for the Ed Banger years.
description: 10th anniversary of the D.A.N.C.E. party at 1720 with Bag Raiders, Uffie and CSS.

curator_note: Free-with-RSVP night at Los Globos, but nobody is billed and bass house leans toward the stuff you skip. Only worth it if the lineup drops and surprises.
description: Free-with-RSVP EMX electronic night at Los Globos; bass house and tech house, lineup unannounced.

curator_note: A house night in the Bellwether's Camille's room the Friday after Thanksgiving, with no names attached yet. Ticketed at $24-30, so wait for the lineup before committing.
description: Black House Radio house music night, 9pm-2am at Camille's at the Bellwether in DTLA.

curator_note: Location-TBA Lincoln Heights party with no lineup or details posted. Warehouse-style, but there is too little to go on; check back closer to the date.
description: Late-night party at a location to be announced in Lincoln Heights; no lineup listed.

artist_notes.name: Arlo Parks
artist_notes.note: London singer-songwriter (Mercury Prize winner); billed here at a dance night, so expect a DJ-style turn rather than a band set.

curator_note: Rhonda is Los Globos' pop-leaning dance party, and booking Arlo Parks and Gabriels turns it into a headline-heavy night. More buzzy than house-head, so go for the novelty rather than the selection.
description: A Club Called Rhonda dance party at Los Globos with Arlo Parks, DRAMA, Gabriels and more.

artist_notes.name: Klangkarussell
artist_notes.note: Austrian duo, 'Sonnentanz' (2012) made them a melodic-house festival name.

curator_note: Big 2012 crossover hit, now a melodic-house touring act that fills 1720. Pleasant and sing-along rather than deep, and $40+ for a headliner-only bill is a bit steep.
description: Austrian melodic house duo Klangkarussell on their Americas 2027 tour at 1720.

curator_note: Free all-nighter at an undisclosed spot an hour out, built on breaks, jungle, psytrance, hardstyle and gabber. The house is incidental; this one is the opposite of the groove you chase, and the drive is real.
description: Free 9pm-5am multi-genre bass and hard-dance party by Psy Opalia at a TBA location outside LA.

curator_note: Free EP release night at Bar Franca, a small DTLA room where the sound system is the point. Local-scale, but a good low-risk Saturday for house and techno heads.
description: Release party for Spacious's Textural EP at Bar Franca with heelbite316 and Emackulate; free entry.

curator_note: Weekly free-with-RSVP Koreatown Friday with disco and house on the menu. Easy drop-in on the way somewhere else, not a destination.
description: Weekly MUZIQUE Fridays dance party at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang with SWOOPS and guests; free with RSVP.
